_doc: The background jobs every machine runs, checked in (tools/jobs/jobs.py). `every`: an opencode automation interval. `run`: a Python script under the repo and its arguments, so Windows and macOS run the same command; `{work}` is the main tree's .work, `{root}` this checkout. `os`: the platforms it runs on (sys.platform), all when absent. `alert_exit`: exit codes that mean an alert, not a failure (role-telemetry's 1: a NEW flag): `jobs.py run` prints ALERT and exits 0. Automations are named `<prefix><name>` (the project's name); `jobs.py sync` creates, replaces and deletes only those.
